ios.desc:
Vibe Canvas is a unique app that allows you to express, track, and analyze your daily emotions through a beautiful digital canvas. Using calming sand simulation effects, you can create stunning visual representations of your moods and gain insights into your emotional well-being.

Learn more at https://www.sandmind.art

Terms of Service: https://www.sandmind.art/terms-and-conditions

Privacy Policy: https://www.sandmind.art/privacy-policy

EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

show_hn.title: Show HN: Paywall Removed – SandMind – Free iOS App

quotes.text:
this update completely removes the paywall for a fully free experience. now you can track your emotions, discover patterns, and monitor anxiety levels with ease.  depression tracking is coming soon, too!

your data stays private and on your device—nothing is tracked except for a simple notification that lets me know when someone creates a canvas. it’s fully anonymous and just gives me motivation, knowing the app is being used.

i removed the paywall because this project was always meant to help people, not make money. mental health tools should be free, and SandMind will stay that way.

roadmap:

- more health screenings (like phq-9)

- apple health support

- local smart notifications

- considering open-sourcing the project

- more… i’m open to any feedback or suggestions

thanks for your support!

https://app.sandmind.art/sandmind-ios
